planned_math_to_code.statement: Linearize the repair as r approximately P xi+B gamma, with phase endpoint offsets zero.
Let M=I-P(P^T W P)^dagger P^T W; after unconstrained phase elimination, gamma*=(B^T W M B+lambda I)^-1 B^T W M r.
For monotone time, impose 1+tau'(t)>0; if the bound is active, solve the full constrained block problem instead of the unconstrained formula.
Overlapping phase/amplitude directions are unidentifiable without extra constraints; residual second-order error is O(||tau||^2).
Let L=W^(1/2), U span range(LP), M0=I-UU^T, and LB=VR with V^T V=I and R invertible. The amplitude data curvature in eta=R gamma is S=V^T M0 V=I-V^T UU^T V.
kappa=lambda_min(S)=1-sigma_max(U^T V)^2; with no phase subspace define the cross singular value as zero. kappa>0 iff M0 V has full column rank.
For kappa>0 and zero ridge, ||Delta eta||<=||e||/sqrt(kappa), and ||Delta gamma||<=||R^-1|| ||e||/sqrt(kappa), for whitened residual perturbation e.
If Bv=Pu!=0, (xi,gamma) and (xi-au,gamma+av) predict identically. Positive amplitude ridge can make its profiled inverse exist without identifying the true decomposition from data.
For original t_j and piecewise-linear internal tau, impose tau_(j+1)-tau_j>=-(1-m)(t_(j+1)-t_j), m>0, and zero endpoint offsets.
For block-diagonal W=diag(w_i I) and ||Y_i second derivative||<=K_i, ||epsilon_linear||_W<=.5 sqrt(sum_i w_i K_i^2 tau_i^4).

math_to_code.s1: solve_phase_amplitude constructs the trajectory derivative times the fixed endpoint-zero phase basis and joins it with the supplied frozen amplitude basis.
math_to_code.s2_s3: The inactive solution is the full weighted block optimum, equivalent to profiling when the stated ranks hold; violated monotonicity enters a full active-set constrained block solve rather than reusing the profiled formula.
math_to_code.s4_s8: Whitened phase/amplitude subspaces produce the principal-angle kappa certificate; rank-deficient or below-floor problems fail closed even when positive ridge makes the numerical system solvable.
math_to_code.s5_s7: The implementation records the largest cross-subspace singular value, kappa and weighted residuals; no coefficient is reported as identified below the prospectively supplied floor.
math_to_code.s9: Every adjacent original interval enforces the minimum warped-time slope and exact endpoint offsets; output interpolation remains on the original timestamp inventory.
math_to_code.s10: The implementation retains the observed weighted nonlinear-versus-linearized remainder. A source-qualified curvature bound and target provenance remain external obligations.
